scope: Whitelisted raw live Codex evidence; historical failures retained verbatim

recovery.metadata_scope: Original metadata loss and reconstruction are described in full/recovery.json; current observations are not substituted for absent original measurements

limitations: Manifest excludes itself to avoid a circular checksum.
Reports retain original artifact pointers; manifest paths identify the public copies.
Untracked-file contents in archives/worktrees are not copied; their names and tracked patch are retained.
Credential-pattern scanning is a guard, not proof of absence of every possible secret.
